newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aderans shares climb to new high for year.
newsitem.headline: Aderans shares climb to new high for year.

text.p: Aderans Co Ltd shares climbed to a new high for the calendar year on Thursday afternoon, encouraged by recent news that Japan's leading wig maker was planning a share repurchase and an increase in its dividend.
At 0404 GMT, the company's shares were up 80 yen at 2,940.
The firm said earlier that it was planning to buy up to two million of its common shares at a cost not exceeding five billion yen.
It also said its ordinary dividend in the 1997/98 business year was forecast at 22.00 yen, up from 20.00 yen in the 1996/97 year ended February 28.
